description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creaitng a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature token with haste named Mishra's Warform in addition to its other types.
Activate Mishra's Warform by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mishra's Warform.
